end.summary:
Practised reading and writing numbers up to 9999 in words and numerals.
Identified that 999 is followed by 1000.
Worked with 1000, 6 thousands, and 42 using place-value language.
The face-value/place-value mix-up for the digit 3 in 3456 was not corrected later in the lesson.
Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Asha practised place value and writing numbers in words and numerals with Diya. Diya correctly connected 4 tens and 2 ones with 42 and identified that 1000 follows 999. They mixed up a digit’s face value with its place value, and this was not corrected later in the lesson. At home, use a place-value chart to build numbers such as 3456 and ask what each digit is worth.
